title: Marketing so good, you couldn’t tell it’s a scam

stated_problem.quote: The jewelers, the retail stores are just keeping the markup 'cause they don't wanna cave and offer lower prices
stated_problem.speaker: Shaan Puri

idea.name: Diamond jewelry retail capturing the lab-grown price collapse
idea.one_liner: Wholesale diamond prices (especially lab-grown) have crashed while retail jewelry prices fell only 15-20%, so jewelers capture a fat margin; consumers struggle to access wholesale stones and set them

key_quotes.quote: So very interestingly, even though the price of the diamonds has fallen off, the price of the store has not been there just capturing a fat margin right now.
I mean, a lab will be 80 to 90% cheaper than the same quality natural diamond.

claims.quote: So they're down 70% from their peak and just like 50% from like COVID times till now.
So lab has become 60 plus percent of the market.
if you go to the jewelry store, they're still roughly the same price of the down like 15, 20%.

stated_problem.quote: Like, if you ever hold up two of the diamonds, can't tell the difference.
stated_problem.speaker: Shaan Puri

idea.name: Neutral third-party grading body for an industry
idea.one_liner: GIA/Michelin-style independent grader whose language (4Cs) enables price discrimination, often funded/promoted by the industry it grades

key_quotes.quote: The four Cs gave them language to use for pricing discrimination.
They'll, they'll sort of fund or promote the, the nonprofit neutral party because it's good for everybody.
